items.prompt: Character reference sheet on a plain pure white background, full-body figures standing side by side in a neutral pose, front three-quarter view, evenly spaced with wide white gaps between them so each can be cut out separately, no shadows on the ground, no background scenery. Left: Maya, an 11-year-old girl with warm brown skin and a big cloud of curly black hair, bright yellow hooded raincoat, blue jeans, red rubber boots, lively curious face. Middle: Grandpa Tomas, a lighthouse keeper in his seventies, tall and slightly stooped, full white beard, bushy white eyebrows, kind crinkled eyes, navy blue cable-knit sweater, dark navy keeper's peaked cap, grey trousers, black boots. Right: Biscuit, a very fat round orange tabby cat with white chest and paws, sitting, smug half-closed eyes.

Two location studies side by side on white, separated by a wide white gap. Left: a red-and-white horizontally striped lighthouse with a black lantern gallery standing on a rocky Atlantic headland, a small white keeper's cottage with a slate roof beside it, a winding path, grey-green sea and low clouds. Right: the cosy round lamp room interior at the top of the lighthouse: the big glass Fresnel lens in the centre, curved windows looking at the sea, a wooden desk with an old valve radio set and a microphone, a stool, a teapot, a knitted blanket. No people, no animals.
